method: Unchanged copies of the existing win-count-loop and win-count-finish assets, with the same 0.35 playback gain and loop-seam overlap as FlightAudio. These two cues are used only by the big-win counter.

clips.usage: Loop only while the big-win amount is counting. Stop before the finish cue, on mute, hiding, dismissal or unmount.
Play once when counting reaches or is skipped to the authoritative final amount.
